verdict: The report is structurally sound: every Section, Chapter, Table (1-17), Algorithm (1-6) and Appendix reference resolves to an existing target, the Contents page numbers match the built headings exactly, the cross-chapter numbers (44 primary studies, 23 core / 21 supporting, 9,256 -> 6,039 -> 3,129 -> 1,800 -> 64 -> 44, six requirements, 23 automated tests, N = |G| with the 2-of-2 configuration, blocks 11,771,243 / 11,771,307 / 11,771,581, tokens #1 and #2, the contract address and transaction hashes) agree everywhere except the Abstract's '33 studies' and one '1,805' in 2.5, and the RO/RQ titles are identical across the Abstract, Table 1, Chapters 3, 4, 6, 7 and the Appendix. The MUST_FIX items are few but visible: the stale Abstract count, an orphan paragraph opening 2.3.7, two placeholder 'S' entries in the Table 9 discussion, a wrong Table 15/16 reference in 9.2, the 6.7 sentences that still assign Eq. (70) to CA3 although RO5 is delivered, equation numbering that starts at (6), and a handful of grammar/orphan lead-ins (6.5, 6.6, 6.8.10) plus the Trusted/Trust Computing and SRQ/RQ inconsistencies. Remaining points (unreferenced Figures 3-5 and 12-40, status paragraphs placed before the objectives they describe, Table 14 caption below the table, R = (u, PR, SR) vs (u, PR, SR, Jur(R)) in 6.4, the trailing sentence at the end of 7.1) are presentational and can be left if time is short.
